authority.source_authority: DAD owns candidate role, skill, registry, workflow, schema, routing, and navigation contracts; project repositories retain local truth and Lowell retains destination, depth, integration, activation, acceptance, and release authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-registry-writer edited the isolated worktree. Both specialists and the independent checker remained read-only; the checker findings were reconciled by the writer and separately replayed.

roles.why_needed: Right-sized diagnosis required independent lifecycle and stopping-boundary expertise.
roles.mission: Design and review the observed-position, human-destination, completion-depth, issue, and sufficient-stop contract.
roles.authority: Read-only specialist; cannot infer destination, mutate project state, or execute work.
acceptance_conditions: Ambiguity defaults to diagnosis and no handoff.
Exact bounded work suppresses the diagnostic.

readiness_conditions: PM vocabulary and human authority are reconciled.

roles.why_needed: Existing parent families needed distinct expert methods without portfolio expansion.
roles.mission: Audit and define bounded MCP and UI/UX specialist methods, activation evidence, suppressors, and validation boundaries.
roles.authority: Read-only specialist; cannot install, activate, contact users, collect data, or mutate systems.
acceptance_conditions: Packs remain members of existing families.
Executable routing selects no more than three roles.
stop_conditions: Incidental files or dependencies activate experts.

readiness_conditions: Roles are deduplicated against existing families.

roles.why_needed: One writer was required for coherent cross-registry implementation and revision after challenge.
roles.mission: Implement candidate skills, packs, schemas, selector, family membership, workflow, navigation, documentation, and tests.
roles.authority: May edit task-scoped DAD artifacts in the isolated worktree only; cannot activate or externally mutate anything.
acceptance_conditions: All material checker blockers are corrected.
stop_conditions: External configuration or credentials are required.

readiness_conditions: Changed paths and exact commands are available.

roles.why_needed: The producer could not validate its own right-sizing and authority claims.
roles.mission: Challenge lifecycle, attestation, routing, graph, MCP, UI/UX, and overbuild claims and replay deterministic evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only checker; cannot edit, activate, approve, or infer the destination.

readiness_conditions: Revised artifacts and commands are frozen.

proof_obligations.description: Diagnosis and routing stop at the smallest human-confirmed outcome.
MCP experts extend the existing family and require named activation evidence.
UI/UX methods are broad but each stage activates only a bounded subset.
Human destination and depth require attestable decision and validation references.

reconciliations.reason: The role found the competing lifecycle and attestation gaps during independent review.
The audit directly informed distinct role methods, suppressors, and parent-family membership.
Single-writer ownership was preserved through implementation and checker-driven revision.
Independent challenge was material and remained read-only.
